new.n: Indian Trail on the 1911 Houghton County plat (T49N R36W)
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (scan 59, T49N R36W east half) draws an 'Indian Trail' running north-south through sections 12, 14, 23, 26 and 34. The line here joins the middles of those sections, so it can be off by up to about 400 m; the plat shows the true bends. One source.
new.t: Old trails follow dry ground between waters; walk the drawn line and look for a worn bench or the line of a later road on top of it. A 'Camp' sits just west of it at SE SE sec. 15.
src: Houghton County plat book, 1911, scan 59 (UMich, via the county-depth thread)
new.v: Coins, trade silver, buttons, old trail relics
pinev: Line joins the section centres; up to about 400 m off the plat bends
